messages.text: BL-1721 🎵 in progress — The unit suite's per-file budget guard refused extension/test/emitLifecycleSnapshotCli.test.js (10.9 s) and extension/test/telegramFrontDeskBotCli.test.js (11.3 s) as new poles on BL-1703's parcel a6a5b51a5c at load about 10 (QA note 003132), though their BL-1633 confirm-alone measures 16 ms and 4.2 s on main - the refusal prints only the in-suite duration, so nobody can tell a slow confirmation from a failed one (a failure counts as over budget); the guard names each offender's alone result or failure, and retries a failed confirmation once before it counts
